from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path
import json

folder = Path('products/services/stream-commerce-catalogue')
price = Decimal('60')
scenarios = []
for hourly_rate in (30, 45, 60):
    for incremental_cost in (0, 5, 10):
        for non_delivery_minutes in (15, 30, 45):
            total_minutes = (price - incremental_cost) * 60 / hourly_rate
            scenarios.append({'hourly_labor_target_cad': hourly_rate, 'assumed_incremental_cost_cad': incremental_cost, 'assumed_acquisition_revision_and_admin_minutes_per_paid_order': non_delivery_minutes, 'maximum_delivery_minutes_at_target': int(total_minutes - non_delivery_minutes)})
result = {'offer': 'Stream Commerce catalogue QA', 'provisional_price_cad': int(price), 'exact_draft_sha256': '4354db998e4f0001ed5c33b9345f7ebc8ef3d8b42fa3b1227eebb9ac290b0c6b', 'scope': 'Sensitivity model only. No measured time, buyer acceptance, verified fees, allocated subscriptions, margin or settlement.', 'application': 'Use a measured delivery rehearsal for the same scope where available. Add acquisition time across successful and unsuccessful leads, divided by paid orders when any exist. Replace all cost and time assumptions as evidence arrives. A negative delivery allowance means the assumed non-delivery work already exceeds the available labor budget.', 'scenarios': scenarios}
assert len(scenarios) == 27
assert any(row['hourly_labor_target_cad'] == 60 and row['assumed_incremental_cost_cad'] == 10 and row['assumed_acquisition_revision_and_admin_minutes_per_paid_order'] == 30 and row['maximum_delivery_minutes_at_target'] == 20 for row in scenarios)
folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path = folder / 'director-cad60-delivery-ceilings.json'
path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
assert json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) == result
print(f'{path}: {len(scenarios)} scenarios verified locally')
